color_protocol.validate_before_decode: PNG signature, chunk bounds/order/uniqueness, all chunk CRCs, IHDR RGB/RGBA8 geometry, alpha transparency declaration and complete IEND. Preserve all native chunks and source byte hashes.
color_protocol.supported: Highest-precedence understood color declaration governs. Supported valid RGB ICC converts to sRGB with profile/intent hashes; legal single sRGB intent0..3 explicitly declares sRGB and permits identity normalization. Pillow ICC absence alone is not failure.
color_protocol.unsupported: An unsupported higher-priority cICP or ambiguous/invalid declaration leaves normalized comparison unresolved; never silently fall back to lower-priority sRGB. gAMA/cHRM-only or unmarked files retained as raw diagnostics, not assumed sRGB.
color_protocol.conflicts: Record conflicting/lower-priority chunks and nonrecommended iCCP+sRGB co-occurrence explicitly; do not strip metadata.
color_protocol.tracks: Keep raw encoded RGBA and normalized-sRGB RGBA separately. Run fixed gates on each supported track; never select whichever track looks better. Missing supported color provenance remains a prospective failure.
color_protocol.normative_reference: W3C PNG Third Edition §4.3/Table1 and §11.3.2.3/5/6, https://www.w3.org/TR/png/

apparent_observables.eligible: Only rows with BOTH original sides individually eligible; preserve all side failures otherwise

apparent_observables.uncertainties: epsW=epsL+epsR; epsC=epsU=(epsL+epsR)/2; epsg=(epsL+epsR)/(2m), minimum1pt at m.25. Propagate source raster quantization floor; no Gaussian independence assumption.
apparent_observables.reverse_test: For each platform/a/d, compare normal and reversed left/right50 coordinates with summed edge uncertainty bounds; retain discrepancies and no averaging rescue.

apparent_observables.platform_comparison: Compare eligible native/Android apparent positions/W/C/g/U and uncertainties per exact source+row; descriptive residuals only, no parity threshold or parameter selection.
